tools.name: disqus_get_forum
tools.description: Get the details of one Disqus forum (site): name, settings, founder and counters.

tools.name: disqus_list_forum_threads
tools.description: List the threads (pages with comments) of a forum, newest first by default.

tools.name: disqus_list_forum_posts
tools.description: List the comments of a forum, newest first by default. Use 'include' to read unapproved, spam or flagged comments (needs moderator rights).

tools.name: disqus_list_posts
tools.description: List comments across the forums the account moderates (or the forums given), by date. Filter by thread, date range or state.

tools.name: disqus_get_thread
tools.description: Get one thread: title, link, counts of comments, likes and state. Find it by id, ident or page URL.

tools.name: disqus_list_thread_posts
tools.description: List the comments of one thread. Find the thread by id, ident or page URL.

tools.name: disqus_get_post
tools.description: Get one comment by id: text, author, state, likes and the thread it belongs to.

tools.name: disqus_get_user
tools.description: Get a Disqus user profile by numeric id or username. With no argument, return the account of the key.

tools.name: disqus_list_most_active_users
tools.description: List the users of a forum ordered by the number of comments they made.

tools.name: disqus_approve_posts
tools.description: WRITE: approve held comments so they show on the site. The account must moderate the forum.

tools.name: disqus_mark_posts_spam
tools.description: WRITE: mark comments as spam. They leave the public thread. The account must moderate the forum.

tools.name: disqus_delete_posts
tools.description: WRITE: delete comments. Ask the user to confirm the ids first.

tools.name: disqus_close_thread
tools.description: WRITE: close a thread so nobody can add new comments. Reversible with disqus_open_thread.

tools.name: disqus_open_thread
tools.description: WRITE: open a closed thread so people can comment again.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: disqus_list_forum_threads, disqus_list_forum_posts, disqus_list_posts, disqus_get_thread, disqus_list_thread_posts, disqus_get_post, disqus_list_most_active_users, disqus_open_thread · Public sink: disqus_get_post · Destructive: disqus_delete_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: disqus_list_forum_threads, disqus_list_forum_posts, disqus_list_posts, disqus_get_thread, disqus_list_thread_posts, disqus_get_post, disqus_list_most_active_users, disqus_open_thread · Public sink: disqus_get_post · Destructive: disqus_delete_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
